subject: Enhance build instructions and settings; refactor connection handling
body:
Enhance build instructions and settings; refactor connection handling

- Updated README.md to include build instructions for Visual Studio Code.
- Changed default setting for UseFilterSearch to true in Settings files.
- Refactored OpenConnectionClickHandler to support multiple selected connections.
- Introduced methods in ConnectionTree for handling multiple connections.
- Simplified connection context menu actions to use new methods.
- Added VS Code configuration files for tasks and launch settings.
- Implemented invoke_msbuild.ps1 for building solutions with MSBuild.

security_flags.reason: scripts execute on a maintainer machine

triage.rationale: VS Code tasks/launch config for their dev setup; we build via build.ps1. Bundles unseen connection-handling refactor (truncated diff) — blind import risky, no mapped issue.
